Team,

Quick reminder: our weekly forecast submission is due EOD Wednesday (June 2). Please update committed amounts in the shared sheet (link below) and add a 1-line close plan for any deals you intend to carry into commit. I attached the current forecast template for convenience.

What I need from everyone by EOD Wed:
- Update stage and $ amounts in the sheet for all open deals (particularly those in Negotiation/Legal).
- Fill the "Close Plan" column: owner, next step, target close date, confidence (High/Med/Low).
- Flag any deals where pricing/terms are blocking progression — note the blocker and suggested remedy.

Prep for Wednesday 9am PST sync (short call):
1) Top 6 at-risk deals (owner + corrective action)
2) Any deals that should be moved to upside vs commit
3) Quick ask list for Finance (discount/one-time credit approvals)

Links/attachments: forecast_template.xlsx (attached), https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3cForecastSheet

If you need an exception to timing (e.g., waiting on legal redlines), reply with who and ETA.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
